decision: Current G81 hypothesis is not validated; repository should preserve the negative evidence and prevent qualitative pseudo-view renders from being reported as success.
findings: The pipeline is now real-GT gated: source-only pseudo-view generation, private pseudo supervision manifests, RI3D training, NeRSemble true-KRT held-out rendering, and G55/G84 evaluator contract all ran.
Identity/confidence-aware supervision gave only a small short-train improvement over naive at iter80, but did not beat direct.
After 1500-step densification, naive exceeded aware; rejecting geometry_only views improved conceptual cleanliness but still did not beat naive or direct.
The direct LAM single-image Gaussian baseline remains far stronger: PSNR 12.690455 / mask IoU 0.900017 versus best pseudo-view RI3D PSNR 4.905284 / mask IoU 0.309711.
Current evidence supports a negative result for naive pseudo-view-to-3DGS supervision under this NeRSemble case, not a positive method claim.
next_gate: Either implement direct-prior pseudo-view refinement with exact held-out renderer, or close this route as a negative result and expand protocol/evaluator contribution across more real-GT cases.
premise: Summarize the completed G81 real-GT held-out camera iterations after G83-G105. The required success condition was identity/confidence-aware pseudo-view supervision beating both direct single-image Gaussian and naive pseudo-view supervision on the same NeRSemble held-out cameras.
recommended_next_milestone: Do not continue the current from-scratch RI3D pseudo-view route as a positive claim. The next credible attempt should be a head-anchored learned-prior refinement: start from a strong direct Gaussian/mesh prior, apply source/identity-only pseudo-view constraints with exact renderer support, and keep the same G84 contract. If that cannot beat direct, reposition the project as a real-GT evaluator/protocol and negative pseudo-view supervision study.
risk_and_limits: G88/G91/G96/G102 use a point-splat diagnostic renderer for RI3D PLYs, not the exact differentiable Gaussian renderer.
No manual/VLM visual gate was completed inside this sandbox; private contact sheets exist under 3dv_work and need human/VLM review.
This is a single source case; it is sufficient to block the current positive claim, not sufficient for broad statistical conclusions.
The direct LAM baseline is likely in or near LAM training distribution for NeRSemble, so it should be labeled an in-domain diagnostic baseline.
